subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on December 15, 2021. Your flight details and e-ticket are attached to this email. Please review the information carefully and feel free to reach out if you have any questions or need assistance. Thank you for choosing our airline for your travel needs. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
